Jamia Millia Islamia to Resume Offline Operations on November 9 Following End of Student Protests

01 Nov 2026, 11:43 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: www.amarujala.com

Campus Reopening Scheduled

Jamia Millia Islamia administration has announced that the university campus will resume full offline operations starting November 9. This follows the conclusion of an 18-day student protest that had previously prompted the university to transition classes to an online format and suspend access to library and canteen facilities.

Key Changes for Students:

  • Offline Classes: Regular classroom instruction will resume following the Diwali break.
  • Facilities: The campus library and canteen services will be fully functional for students.
  • Campus Environment: Maintenance and cleaning operations are currently underway to prepare the grounds for the return of the student body.

Context of the Resolution

According to university officials, the decision marks the end of a period of unrest centered on several student demands, most notably the reinstatement of student union elections, which have not been held at the institution for two decades. University representatives reported that the impasse was resolved after approximately eight rounds of negotiations between administration officials and protesting students.

Staff and Administrative Response

On Friday, a gathering held at the Ansari Auditorium featured more than 2,000 teaching and non-teaching staff members. During the event, participants expressed satisfaction with the resolution, framing the agreement as a victory for dialogue and academic harmony rather than a triumph for any single party.

While the resolution of the protests was welcomed, some staff members have requested that the administration investigate reports of property damage and the use of inflammatory slogans during the 18-day period. The administration has emphasized that the transition back to normal operations is intended to restore the academic environment for all students.

How to Verify

To verify the specific schedule for individual departments or academic updates regarding the resumption of services, students and stakeholders should refer to the official Jamia Millia Islamia website (jmi.ac.in) for circulars and notifications issued by the Registrar or the Proctor's office.
